title: 66:18b I will gather all nations and tongues. The gathering of Israel was prophesied by Moses (Deut. 30:3). The Lord allowed the dispersion of Israel because of her wickedness; but he also promised her return (11:12; 43:5; 49:18). The gathering involves bringing souls unto the gospel covenant; it also involves a physical gathering of people to the land and city of Zion.
author: Tina M. Peterson
